_: DESIGNED, not recovered: unknown spawn type id (absent from the client's mobs.xml) -> a known creature of the same faction and the nearest level, so that battle camps are not empty. Applied by server/rooms.py only in war=1 locations and only for hostile (root 0) creatures. faction = name prefix (ja_ Джанджавиды, mg_ Магриб, nc_ Новые Колонисты, lu_ Люшер, st_ Работорговцы, zd_ Живодеры, jm_ ДСР, pc_ Миротворцы, pt_ Пираты, na_ Северный Альянс, ...); how = camp_fn (Bandit_CampN / Up_Camp_*LVL_NN) or neighbours (prefix of the known hostiles in the same file); level from the file name (*LVL), the known neighbours, or the faction's median. Built by data/build_spawn_substitutes.py.
